sentences.en: On January 28th, 2021, Vicha Ratanapakti set out for his usual morning walk.
sentences.zh: 2021年1月28日，维查·拉塔纳帕克提像往常一样出门晨练。

sentences.en: Vicha was 84, from Thailand, but he'd moved to San Francisco to be closer to his daughter and her family.
sentences.zh: 维查今年84岁，来自泰国，为了离女儿一家更近，他搬到了旧金山。

sentences.en: Security camera footage showed Vicha pausing near someone's driveway.
sentences.zh: 监控录像显示，维查在某人的车道旁停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Suddenly, another much taller man ran toward him and slammed him to the ground, hard.
sentences.zh: 突然，另一个身材高大得多的男人冲向他，狠狠地将他撞倒在地。

sentences.en: Vicha died in the hospital two days later.
sentences.zh: 两天后，维查在医院去世。

sentences.en: My name's Jaya Lee, and I'm a contributor to the New York Times Magazine.
sentences.zh: 我叫贾雅·李，是《纽约时报杂志》的撰稿人。

sentences.en: Like many people, I first came across Vicha's story by watching the security camera footage.
sentences.zh: 和许多人一样，我最初是通过观看监控录像了解到维查的故事的。

sentences.en: It went viral on social media.
sentences.zh: 这段视频在社交媒体上疯传。

sentences.en: That same week, there had been a cluster of attacks against Asian elders, and Vicha quickly became a symbol of the violence against Asian Americans that appeared to be on the rise.
sentences.zh: 就在那一周，针对亚裔长者的袭击事件频发，维查很快成为了针对亚裔美国人暴力事件日益增多的象征。

sentences.en: When I finally spoke to Vicha's family, they kept coming back to, why?
sentences.zh: 当我最终采访维查的家人时，他们不断地问：为什么？

sentences.en: Why did this happen to their father?
sentences.zh: 为什么这种事会发生在他们父亲身上？

sentences.en: To someone they loved so much?
sentences.zh: 发生在他们如此深爱的人身上？

sentences.en: The answers didn't come easy.
sentences.zh: 答案并不容易找到。

sentences.en: Eventually, we learned that there were no known explicit expressions of racism when Vicha was shoved to the ground that morning.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们了解到，那天早上维查被推倒时，并没有明显的种族主义言论。

sentences.en: No obvious hateful slurs, no references to the coronavirus or to China.
sentences.zh: 没有明显的仇恨辱骂，也没有提到新冠病毒或中国。

sentences.en: And because the person accused of killing Vicha was a young Black man, it brought up racial tensions that had been simmering for decades.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于被指控杀害维查的人是一名年轻的黑人男子，这引发了数十年来一直暗流涌动的种族紧张关系。

sentences.en: Even within Asian American communities, everyone agreed the violence needed to stop.
sentences.zh: 即使在亚裔美国人社区内部，大家也都一致认为这种暴力行为必须停止。

sentences.en: But how to get there, and what justice would even look like, that's where things got complicated.
sentences.zh: 但如何实现这一目标，以及正义究竟意味着什么，这才是问题的复杂之处。

sentences.en: So here's my story.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的故事。

sentences.en: Why was Vicha Ratanapakti killed?
sentences.zh: 维查·拉塔纳帕克提为何被杀？

sentences.zh: 由艾米丽·吴·泽勒朗读。

sentences.en: For weeks, Mantanas Ratanapakti urged her parents to please stay inside.
sentences.zh: 几周以来，曼塔纳斯·拉塔纳帕克提一直恳求父母待在家里。

sentences.en: An uneasiness had hung over her ever since a mob descended on the Capitol early that month.
sentences.zh: 自从本月初暴徒冲击国会大厦以来，她一直感到不安。

sentences.en: Though really, people had been acting crazy for a year.
sentences.zh: 虽然说实话，人们已经疯狂了一整年了。

sentences.en: Throughout 2020, multiple strangers had come at her seemingly out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 整个2020年，有多个陌生人似乎毫无缘由地找过她的麻烦。

sentences.en: That January, an old man yelled at her in Golden Gate Park, something about a virus and going back
sentences.zh: 那年一月，一位老人在金门公园对她大喊大叫，说了一些关于病毒和回

sentences.en: to her country, while she watched her sons, then ten and seven, run in a playground.
sentences.zh: 她自己国家的话，当时她正看着她十岁和七岁的儿子在操场上奔跑。

sentences.en: In February, two joggers, women, yelled something about germs at her older son as he played on a dock with a friend.
sentences.zh: 二月，两名女性慢跑者在她大儿子与朋友在码头玩耍时，对他大喊了一些关于病菌的话。

sentences.en: In March, just before the country went into lockdown, a woman swung at Mantanas outside a hospital.
sentences.zh: 三月，就在全国进入封锁状态前夕，一名女子在医院外向曼塔纳斯挥拳。

sentences.en: She ducked the punch before running across the street.
sentences.zh: 她躲过了那一拳，然后跑过了马路。

sentences.en: In November, another old man spat in her direction as her sons rode their scooters by the bay.
sentences.zh: 十一月，另一位老人在她儿子们在海湾边骑滑板车时，朝她的方向吐口水。

sentences.en: When Mantanas talked about these incidents, how the outside world didn't feel safe anymore, her father would ask, is it really that bad?
sentences.zh: 当曼塔纳斯谈到这些事件，谈到外面的世界感觉不再安全时，她的父亲会问：真的有那么糟糕吗？

sentences.en: A petite 84-year-old with soft white hair,
sentences.zh: 维查·拉塔纳帕克提是一位身材娇小、有着柔软白发、84岁的老人，

sentences.en: Vichar Ratanapakti was a lifelong Buddhist, the kind of person who embraced the world with open arMs.
sentences.zh: 他是一位终身佛教徒，那种张开双臂拥抱世界的人。

sentences.en: When Mantanas had a gripe with the landlord or a stranger who crossed her, he would tell her to let it go, to leave it to karma.
sentences.zh: 当曼塔纳斯与房东或冒犯她的陌生人发生争执时，他会告诉她要放下，让因果报应去处理。

sentences.en: He often lightened the mood after she argued with her husband, teasing that his daughter talked too much.
sentences.zh: 在曼塔纳斯与丈夫争吵后，他经常会调侃女儿话太多，以此来缓和气氛。

sentences.en: Mantanas didn't always agree with her father, but she loved his spirit.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯并不总是同意父亲的观点，但她热爱他的精神。

sentences.en: This January, Vichar was eager to regain his stamina after a recent series of heart operations, so that he could walk again for longer distances.
sentences.zh: 今年一月，维查渴望在最近的一系列心脏手术后恢复体力，以便能再次进行长距离行走。

sentences.en: Walking was how he explored San Francisco when he first arrived there from Thailand in 2000, to spend a year with Mantanas while she attended business
sentences.zh: 2000年，他从泰国初次抵达旧金山时，就是通过步行来探索这座城市的，当时他陪曼塔纳斯度过了一年，而她正在读商学院；

sentences.en: school, and again in 2018, to help take care of her two sons.
sentences.zh: 2018年，他又来到这里帮忙照顾她的两个儿子。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, Vichar usually left the house before 8am and made it back before his grandsons started their Zoom classes.
sentences.zh: 疫情期间，维查通常在早上8点前出门，并在孙子们开始 Zoom 网课前赶回家。

sentences.en: On the morning of January 28th, when Mantanas and the children were still asleep, he prepared to head out.
sentences.zh: 1月28日那天早上，当曼塔纳斯和孩子们还在睡觉时，他准备出门。

sentences.en: His wife suggested that he have some coffee firSt. He told her he wouldn't be gone for long, whispering so as not to wake the kids.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子建议他先喝杯咖啡。他告诉她不会去太久，并压低声音以免吵醒孩子们。

sentences.en: Then, in a jacket, jeans, and a white baseball cap, he slipped out of the apartment, down two flights of stairs, and into the foggy morning.
sentences.zh: 然后，他穿着夹克、牛仔裤，戴着白色棒球帽，溜出了公寓，走下两层楼梯，步入了雾蒙蒙的清晨。

sentences.en: The neighborhood of Anza Vista, tucked on a hilltop away from traffic, was usually quiet.
sentences.zh: 安扎维斯塔社区坐落在远离交通的山顶上，通常很安静。

sentences.en: On the corner where Vichar paused in his steps, there's a view of the bay and the skyscrapers downtown.
sentences.zh: 在维查停下脚步的街角，可以看到海湾和市中心的摩天大楼。

sentences.en: A surveillance video captured what happened next.
sentences.zh: 监控视频记录下了接下来发生的事情。

sentences.en: The footage is grainy and brief.
sentences.zh: 画面模糊且短暂。

sentences.en: A tall figure suddenly darts across a street and slams into a much smaller one.
sentences.zh: 一个高大的身影突然冲过马路，猛地撞向一个身材矮小得多的人。

sentences.en: The smaller figure crumples onto the pavement and doesn't get back up.
sentences.zh: 那个矮小的身影瘫倒在人行道上，再也没有起来。

sentences.en: The white baseball cap flutters to the ground, like a leaf falling from a tree.
sentences.zh: 那顶白色棒球帽飘落在地，就像一片从树上落下的叶子。

sentences.en: After her son's Zoom classes on January 28th, Mantanas began to worry about where her father was.
sentences.zh: 1月28日，在儿子们的 Zoom 网课结束后，曼塔纳斯开始担心父亲去哪了。

sentences.en: Maybe he went to Target, a few blocks from their home, where he liked to grab a coffee and browse the aisles.
sentences.zh: 也许他去了离家几个街区的塔吉特百货，他喜欢在那里喝杯咖啡，逛逛货架。

sentences.en: During the pandemic, she persuaded him to avoid shopping and stick to outdoor walks.
sentences.zh: 疫情期间，她曾说服他减少购物，坚持户外散步。

sentences.en: She had even persuaded him to leave his wallet at home, at least for another few weeks, when he was scheduled for his second shot of the coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 她甚至说服他把钱包留在家里，至少再坚持几周，直到他预定接种第二剂新冠疫苗的时候。

sentences.en: She stepped out to check the front and the back of their building.
sentences.zh: 她出门检查了楼房的前后。

sentences.en: The streets were quiet.
sentences.zh: 街道很安静。

sentences.en: When she came back in, she noticed his tablet was gone.
sentences.zh: 当她回到屋里时，发现他的平板电脑不见了。

sentences.en: She tried calling it.
sentences.zh: 她试着拨打那个号码。

sentences.en: A strange voice picked up.
sentences.zh: 一个陌生的声音接听了。

sentences.en: Her father had been assaulted and taken to a hospital, a police officer said.
sentences.zh: 一名警官说，她的父亲遭到了袭击，已被送往医院。

sentences.en: She heard him say, severe trauma.
sentences.zh: 她听到他说：严重创伤。

sentences.en: The officer said she would have to call the hospital to find out more.
sentences.zh: 警官说她得给医院打电话才能了解更多信息。

sentences.en: The nurse who picked up, however, only had more questions.
sentences.zh: 然而，接电话的护士却提出了更多问题。

sentences.en: No one had been able to identify Weicha.
sentences.zh: 没有人能确认维查的身份。

sentences.en: His pockets contained a quarter and a pair of keys.
sentences.zh: 他的口袋里只有一枚25美分硬币和一把钥匙。

sentences.en: Mantanas gave the nurse her father's name, his medical record number, and his six prescriptions, which included a high dose of blood thinners.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯向护士提供了父亲的姓名、病历号以及他服用的六种处方药，其中包括大剂量的血液稀释剂。

sentences.en: For the past two years, Mantanas had started taking care of her parents more intensely, after her mother was diagnosed with dementia and her father with three clogged arteries.
sentences.zh: 过去两年里，在母亲被诊断出患有痴呆症、父亲有三条动脉堵塞后，曼塔纳斯开始更细心地照顾父母。

sentences.en: As Weicha recovered from each operation, Mantanas had slept on the floor next to his bed, comforting him through the pain.
sentences.zh: 在维查每次手术康复期间，曼塔纳斯都睡在他床边的地板上，在痛苦中安慰他。

sentences.en: A few hours after speaking with the nurse, a doctor called to ask permission to insert a catheter into a vein in his neck and drill a small hole into his
sentences.zh: 与护士通话几小时后，一名医生打来电话，请求允许在他的颈部静脉插入导管，并在他的

sentences.en: skull, to release pressure from bleeding.
sentences.zh: 颅骨上钻一个小孔，以释放出血造成的压力。

sentences.en: Mantanas agreed, even as her worry turned to panic.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯同意了，尽管她的担忧已转为恐慌。

sentences.en: Can I see my father?
sentences.zh: 我可以见见我父亲吗？

sentences.en: She asked.
sentences.zh: 她问道。

sentences.en: She told her husband, Eric Lawson, who rushed home from the restaurant where he worked.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了丈夫埃里克·劳森，他从工作的餐厅匆忙赶回家。

sentences.en: That evening, the couple stood at the doorway to her father's room on the third floor intensive care unit.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，这对夫妇站在三楼重症监护室父亲病房的门口。

sentences.en: A long, thick tube protruded from Weicha's head.
sentences.zh: 一根又长又粗的管子从维查的头部伸出来。

sentences.en: Intravenous lines and electrode patches linked his body to a constellation of machines and bags of fluid.
sentences.zh: 静脉输液管和电极贴片将他的身体与一系列机器和输液袋连接在一起。

sentences.en: Mantanas ran to her father's side and held his hand.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯跑到父亲身边，握住他的手。

sentences.en: Pa, can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 爸，你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: She repeated.
sentences.zh: 她重复道。

sentences.en: A nurse came in and explained that the surgeon hadn't been able to stop the bleeding.
sentences.zh: 一名护士走进来解释说，外科医生没能止住出血。

sentences.en: Weicha had lost so much blood by then that even if a second operation succeeded, he would almost certainly lose his most basic functions for the rest of his life.
sentences.zh: 到那时，维查已经失血过多，即使第二次手术成功，他也几乎肯定会终身丧失最基本的功能。

sentences.en: At one point, a neurologist hinted that if it were his father, he would most likely take him off life support.
sentences.zh: 有一次，一位神经科医生暗示，如果那是他的父亲，他很可能会拔掉生命维持系统。

sentences.en: Mantanas didn't hesitate.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯没有犹豫。

sentences.en: She wanted to keep him alive.
sentences.zh: 她想让他活下去。

sentences.en: I'm fine, even if he's in a wheelchair or doesn't wake up, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说：我没关系，即使他坐轮椅或者醒不过来，我也愿意。

sentences.en: She never got to decide.
sentences.zh: 她最终没能做出决定。

sentences.en: Two days after entering the hospital, just before dawn, Weicha died in his sleep.
sentences.zh: 入院两天后，黎明前夕，维查在睡梦中去世了。

sentences.en: Mantanas was alone in the room with her sister on FaceTime.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯独自在房间里，通过 FaceTime 与姐姐通话。

sentences.en: She watched him for several more hours, his hand in hers.
sentences.zh: 她又守了他几个小时，手一直握着他的手。

sentences.en: Shortly after Weicha was pronounced dead, Mantanas' phone rang.
sentences.zh: 在维查被宣布死亡后不久，曼塔纳斯的电话响了。

sentences.en: A homicide detective gave his condolences and said they were planning to charge the attack as a murder.
sentences.zh: 一名凶杀案侦探表示哀悼，并称他们计划将此次袭击定性为谋杀。

sentences.en: Why would you call me when my father just died?
sentences.zh: 我父亲刚去世，你为什么要给我打电话？

sentences.en: Mantanas wondered at first, her mind thick with shock.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯起初感到困惑，大脑一片空白。

sentences.en: She had learned small details about the suspect from her initial conversations with the police.
sentences.zh: 她从与警方的初步交谈中得知了关于嫌疑人的一些细节。

sentences.en: Male, 19 years old, African American.
sentences.zh: 男性，19岁，非裔美国人。

sentences.en: But her mind swirled with bigger questions.
sentences.zh: 但她的脑海中萦绕着更大的疑问。

sentences.en: Where did the assault happen?
sentences.zh: 袭击发生在哪里？

sentences.en: What made her father bleed out like that?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致父亲流血不止？

sentences.en: How long did he lie outside before an ambulance arrived?
sentences.zh: 在救护车到达之前，他在外面躺了多久？

sentences.en: What kind of person would do this?
sentences.zh: 什么样的人会做出这种事？

sentences.en: The next day, Mantanas tried to retrace her father's steps.
sentences.zh: 第二天，曼塔纳斯试图重走父亲的路线。

sentences.en: She guessed he would have walked in a clockwise loop from their building.
sentences.zh: 她猜测他会从他们大楼出发，走一个顺时针的环形路线。

sentences.en: She often suggested he take that route because it included an uphill stretch that would help him get some cardio.
sentences.zh: 她经常建议他走那条路，因为它包含一段上坡路，有助于他进行有氧运动。

sentences.en: When she made it to the hill, she noticed a neighbor working in his garage and asked if he knew where the episode happened the other day.
sentences.zh: 当她走到那个坡道时，注意到一位邻居正在车库里干活，便问他是否知道前几天发生的事情在哪里。

sentences.en: The neighbor didn't appear to speak English, but he pointed toward her and shouted, right there.
sentences.zh: 邻居似乎不会说英语，但他指着她那边大喊：就在那儿。

sentences.en: Mantanas looked down.
sentences.zh: 曼塔纳斯低头看去。

sentences.en: A few steps away, she noticed a dark stain at the end of a driveway.
sentences.zh: 几步之外，她注意到车道尽头有一块深色的污渍。

sentences.en: It looked like blood, but she wasn't sure.
sentences.zh: 看起来像血迹，但她不确定。

sentences.en: Mantanas sat on her bed that evening with Eric and their 11-year-old son Titus, googling her father's age and the cross street where she found the stain.

sentences.zh: 一位也在搜索的好友发给她两个链接，模糊地提到了维查，其中包括一篇中文文章，

sentences.zh: 午夜左右，在埃里克和孩子们上床睡觉后，两个女人带着水桶、手套和洗碗刷开车去了那个街角。

sentences.en: But Jung grew wary when a doctor asked him if he had recently been to China, and again when he learned that his relatives
sentences.zh: 但当医生问Jung最近是否去过中国时，他开始警觉起来；后来得知他的亲戚们

sentences.en: Knowing what happened with SARS, how Asians were going to get shunned, harassed, he says, referring to the 2003 outbreak.
sentences.zh: 他说，联想到2003年的疫情，他知道SARS期间发生过什么，知道亚裔将如何遭到排斥和骚扰。

sentences.zh: 这些报告来自31个州和哥伦比亚特区，其中近一半来自加州和纽约州。

sentences.zh: 他的母亲是墨西哥人，他认同自己是混血儿。

sentences.zh: Evan Cernofsky的首次采访。

sentences.zh: Nguyen对着镜头说：主流媒体对我们的故事关注不够，她敦促她庞大的粉丝群分享这个故事并标记CNN和MSNBC。

sentences.zh: 我知道这太疯狂了，他说，但我有时确实会有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I wonder if it's my inner racism coming out, or am I just sensitive, or is this my trauma?
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是我内心深处的种族偏见在作祟，还是我太敏感了，又或者是我的创伤反应？

sentences.en: I'm not a judge,
sentences.zh: 我不是法官，

sentences.en: I'm not a lawyer,
sentences.zh: 我不是律师，

sentences.en: I'm not a cop,
sentences.zh: 我不是警察，

sentences.en: I'm just a human being who feels things.
sentences.zh: 我只是一个有血有肉、会产生情感的人。

sentences.en: He pondered this while sitting in his car, in the spot where Antoine reportedly parked on the morning of the attack on Weechaw.
sentences.zh: 他坐在车里思考着这些，就在据报道安托万在袭击威查那天早上停车的地方。

sentences.en: Grandpa died as a result of Antoine not being arrested for reckless driving, he said, and then not having proper services to come out and talk to him while he's out here
sentences.zh: 爷爷的死是因为安托万没有因鲁莽驾驶被捕，他说，而且在他出来后，没有得到适当的服务来和他沟通，

sentences.en: yelling all morning.
sentences.zh: 他整天都在大喊大叫。

sentences.en: He thought about
sentences.zh: 他想到了

sentences.en: Antoine's family, and something his friend once told him, about how when his son had issues with another family, he would meet with them to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 安托万的家人，还有他朋友曾经告诉过他的一件事：当他儿子和另一个家庭发生矛盾时，他会去和他们谈谈。

sentences.en: I have this weird, stupid fantasy,
sentences.zh: 我有一个奇怪又愚蠢的幻想，

sentences.en: Eric said.
sentences.zh: 埃里克说。

sentences.en: The future me, the real me, says, I wish we could forgive everybody, and everybody should acknowledge this bad thing happened, and right now it feels like maybe his family
sentences.zh: 未来的我，真实的我，说，我希望我们能原谅所有人，每个人都应该承认这件坏事发生了，而现在感觉好像他的家人

sentences.en: sees me as an enemy, and in a way I kind of am, but I don't want it to be like that.
sentences.zh: 把我视为敌人，某种程度上我确实是，但我不想这样。

sentences.en: I want to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: I want to know the truth.
sentences.zh: 我想知道真相。

sentences.en: I just want to know why he did it,
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道他为什么要这么做，

sentences.en: and once I hear that,
sentences.zh: 一旦我听到了答案，

sentences.en: I don't think we have a choice but to accept it.
sentences.zh: 我想我们别无选择，只能接受。

sentences.en: I don't know if we can, you know, let him go, he added.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们是否能，你知道，放过他，他补充道。

sentences.en: I think he has to pay for what he did,
sentences.zh: 我认为他必须为自己的所作所为付出代价，

sentences.en: but once he does, we should work out some kind of situation where we could forgive somehow and move on with our life.
sentences.zh: 但一旦他付出了代价，我们应该商量出某种方式，让我们能以某种方式原谅并继续我们的生活。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you're going to have that forever, but maybe we're going to be hurt forever anyway.
sentences.zh: 否则，这种痛苦会伴随你一生，但也许无论如何我们都会永远受伤。

sentences.en: One hundred days after her father's death,
sentences.zh: 在父亲去世一百天后，

sentences.en: Montanus boarded a boat with Eric, their sons, and a few friends.
sentences.zh: 蒙塔努斯和埃里克、他们的儿子以及几位朋友登上一艘船。

sentences.en: Three monks carried piles of orchids and roses, a framed photo of Ouija, and a forest green box holding his remains.
sentences.zh: 三位僧侣带着成堆的兰花和玫瑰、一张威查的装裱照片，以及一个装着他骨灰的森林绿盒子。

sentences.en: Their marigold robes glowed in the sun.
sentences.zh: 他们金盏花色的长袍在阳光下熠熠生辉。

sentences.en: Montanus wore a black wool cloak over a pleated dress that flew up as the boat pulled away from the dock.
sentences.zh: 蒙塔努斯穿着一件黑色羊毛斗篷，里面是一条百褶裙，当船离开码头时，裙摆随风飘动。

sentences.en: Titus, dressed in a black suit and a pair of his grandfather's leather loafers that fit tight around his growing feet, chased his little brother around the deck.
sentences.zh: 泰特斯穿着一套黑色西装，脚上穿着一双对他正在长大的脚来说有点紧的祖父的皮乐福鞋，在甲板上追逐着他的弟弟。

sentences.en: They sailed toward the Golden Gate Bridge, the choppy waters jostling them as they chanted the five precepts.
sentences.zh: 他们驶向金门大桥，波涛汹涌的海水摇晃着船身，他们吟诵着五戒。

sentences.en: A web camera streamed the ceremony for friends and family abroad.
sentences.zh: 一个网络摄像头为海外的亲友直播了这场仪式。

sentences.en: Before his third heart operation,
sentences.zh: 在第三次心脏手术前，

sentences.en: Ouija debated whether to go through with the procedure.
sentences.zh: 威查曾犹豫是否要进行手术。

sentences.en: He wasn't sure if he would make it.
sentences.zh: 他不确定自己能否挺过来。

sentences.en: He told Montanus that when the time came, he wanted to be scattered in the bay, the place that became his home.
sentences.zh: 他告诉蒙塔努斯，当那一天到来时，他希望被撒在海湾里，那个已经成为他家的地方。

sentences.en: You're going to survive,
sentences.zh: 你会活下来的，

sentences.en: Dad,
sentences.zh: 爸爸，

sentences.en: Montanus told him.
sentences.zh: 蒙塔努斯告诉他。

sentences.en: I'm going to take care of you.
sentences.zh: 我会照顾你的。

sentences.en: You have to live longer so you can watch
sentences.zh: 你必须活得更久，这样你才能看到

sentences.en: Titus graduate from college.
sentences.zh: 泰特斯大学毕业。

sentences.en: On the far side of the bridge, where the bay meets the Pacific, the engine stopped.
sentences.zh: 在大桥的另一端，海湾与太平洋交汇处，引擎停止了。

sentences.en: The group filed out to the edge of the deck.
sentences.zh: 一行人走到甲板边缘。

sentences.en: Everyone fell silent.
sentences.zh: 所有人都沉默了。

sentences.en: A monk leaned over and gently shook
sentences.zh: 一位僧侣俯下身，轻轻地将

sentences.en: Ouija's ashes into the lapping waves.
sentences.zh: 威查的骨灰撒入拍打的浪花中。

sentences.en: Friends scattered the flower petals.
sentences.zh: 朋友们撒下了花瓣。

sentences.en: Montanus wailed softly.
sentences.zh: 蒙塔努斯低声哀哭。

sentences.en: Eric held her, and she held her sons.
sentences.zh: 埃里克抱着她，她抱着她的儿子们。

sentences.en: As she watched the parade of flowers and ashes float out to sea, she spoke to him.
sentences.zh: 当她看着花瓣和骨灰随波逐流向大海时，她对他说了话。

sentences.en: I kept my promise,
sentences.zh: 我遵守了我的诺言，

sentences.en: Dad, she said.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，她说。

sentences.en: In the next life,
sentences.zh: 在来世，

sentences.en: I hope I'll get to be your daughter again.
sentences.zh: 我希望我还能做你的女儿。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: I'm sorry!
sentences.zh: 对不起！

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一期节目中，我是

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的人们的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
